title: An Ancient Cistern in the Grounds of Government House, Jerusalem
author: D. C. Baramki
location_note: Grounds of Government House (Jebel Mukabbir), Jerusalem; no map reference; placed by name.
notes: Found by labourers planting trees; cleared by the Department. Late Bronze Age pottery groups, a XVIIIth-Dynasty scarab and a bronze dagger on a later pavement inside; Iron Age to Byzantine sherds below the pavement (excavator: fallen through the roof hole). Bones not human.

features.subtype: rock-cut cistern shaped like a spinning-top, roof opening and side entrance with rock-cut and built steps; later paved; Late Bronze Age deposit (excavator: 'ancient cistern')
features.period: Late Bronze Age contents (second part of the period); cutting not dated
